title: IP RAPID party activity — 25000-record prefix pilot
selection_rationale: Party involvement in IP applications, with ABNs where supplied; deliberately includes different party types and roles.
notes: Prefix cohort of party_activity.csv, not the whole archive. No joins to application status, descriptions or classifications. Parties include organisations, individuals and agents; applicant, patentee and agent roles are distinct. A current party activity is not evidence the IP right is currently enforceable. Activity dates are not company incorporation dates. Do not infer legal company status from a name or ABN. IP RAPID is a weekly updated version of IP Australia's open data product, previously released under the name IPGOD.

acquisition.selection: First 25000 CSV records, no filtering; headers and values preserved; CSV serialization normalized.
acquisition.limitation: Prefix-biased acquisition cohort; not full archive ingestion. Full-member CRC cannot be verified from a partial stream.
